newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gresik sees '97 sales growth of 10-15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gresik sees '97 sales growth of 10-15 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's cement maker PT Semen Gresik expects to post a net sales growth of 10 to 15 percent in 1997 following a slowdown due to the 29 May general elections, Bisnis Indonesia reported on Friday.

"The sales ... would grow by 10 percent to 15 percent because during the first quarter of this year (sales) only grew by 10 percent as many developers postponed their projects," president director Urip Timuryono told reporters after a shareholders meeting on Thursday.
Semen Gresik officials were not immediately available for comment.
Semen Gresik posted net sales of 1.36 trillion rupiah in 1996 against 820.93 billion rupiah in 1995 and a net profit of 219.27 billion rupiah in 1996 against 162.55 billion rupiah in 1995.
Gresik posted a net profit of 35.42 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 41.20 billion rupiah in the same period of 1996.
It posted net sales of 318.28 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 289.92 billion rupiah in the year-ago period. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
